name: Kingmaker Foods
old_description: We use our innovative state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities to produce safe, quality, fresh food products with consistent taste and innovative flavors. With a commitment to making the finest products available to grow our customer’s brands; we source the best possible ingredients from around the world to those available in our backyard. With some of the most experienced industry professionals, the Kingmaker Foods team brings a unique knowledge and problem solving mentality that allows us to take on challenges that others cannot.
about:
Kingmaker Foods operates from a facility at 7698 Zionsville Road in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company runs a state-of-the-art food manufacturing plant focused on producing safe, quality fresh food products for customer brands.

The plant provides liquid and dry processing capabilities supported by an in-house R&D team that includes a culinary research chef. Services span recipe development, packaging design, commercialization, shelf-life testing, nutrition labeling, and food safety regulatory compliance. The facility is SQF Level 3 certified and GFSI-recognized, with on-site laboratories and built-in quality controls that ensure conformance throughout production.

Kingmaker Foods serves food manufacturers and brands seeking scalable turnkey solutions for liquid or dry food products. Its customer base includes companies that need co-manufacturing support for large-scale production and packaging of food items.

The company emphasizes a problem-solving mentality, innovation, and flexibility. It cites a 99% production service level, quick turnaround on time-sensitive projects, adaptable packaging and fill requirements, and an industry-leading commitment to safety certifications as key differentiators.
